**Activate—Luminous Lure** ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [light](/Traits.aspx?ID=640), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645), [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=647), [visual](/Traits.aspx?ID=727)) **Frequency** once per day; **Effect** The _mamlambo scale_ sheds [dim light](/Rules.aspx?ID=2403) in a 20-foot [emanation](/Rules.aspx?ID=2387). The light has a duration of 1 minute, but you can extinguish the light with an [Interact](/Actions.aspx?ID=2297) action. A creature that begins its turn in the light must attempt a DC 26 Will save. Regardless of the save’s result, the creature is temporarily immune for 1 hour. **Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.
**Success** The creature is [slowed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=92) 1 for 1 round.
**Failure** The creature is [fascinated](/Conditions.aspx?ID=72), and for as long as it remains in the light, it must spend at least 1 of its actions on each of its turns to move closer to the source of the light. If the creature ends its movement adjacent to you, it is [slowed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=92) 1 until it is out of the light or until you make a [Strike](/Actions.aspx?ID=2306) against it.
**Critical Failure** As failure, but the creature is also [off-guard](/Conditions.aspx?ID=58) against the first Strike you make against it while it is slowed.
